title: Staged Zero-Sum Topic Catalog
body_html:
Staged Zero-Sum Topic Catalog

Canonical folder topic: zero_sum

Subtopics

  • zero_sum.core - zero-sum games, matrix games, values, guarantees, saddle points, and supports.
  • zero_sum.minimax - minimax theorem statements and proof routes from Loomis, Ville, Sion, LP duality, and approachability.
  • zero_sum.continuous - compact/convex minimax, Sion variants, mixed strategy pathologies, and boundary counterexamples.
  • zero_sum.fictitious_play - fictitious play, empirical frequencies, Robinson proof, and convergence targets.
  • zero_sum.operators - value operators, nonexpansiveness, directional derivatives, and monotone limits.
  • zero_sum.examples - matching pennies, duels, diagonal games, two-by-two formulae, and failure examples.
  • zero_sum.lp - LP complementarity and strong-complementarity bridge statements.

Boundary

Use zero_sum, not zerosum, for new ids and references.
